title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: responder transcript_4 uses plaintext instead of ciphertext (RFC 9528 violation)
description:
In rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:1343, the responder-side `finish_process_message_3` calls `transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &pending.plaintext, peer.credential)` with 3 arguments, but `transcript_4` (line 434) only takes 2: `(th_3: &[u8; 32], ciphertext_3: &[u8])`.

Per RFC 9528 Section 7.4, TH_4 = H(TH_3 || CIPHERTEXT_3), not PLAINTEXT_3. The initiator side (line 915) correctly uses `transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &ciphertext_3.0)`.

The commit under review fixed the corresponding test call (line 1633) from `transcript_4(&th_3, &plaintext_3, &credential_i)` to `transcript_4(&th_3, &ciphertext_3)`, but the production code on line 1343 was not fixed.

To fix: the received CIPHERTEXT_3 (not PLAINTEXT_3) must be used. This likely requires storing the raw ciphertext in `PendingMessage3` since `finish_process_message_3` only has access to `pending.plaintext`.
